name: mortgate-cowork
description: Mortgate evidence-review skills for Microsoft Copilot Cowork, projected for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenWork: mortgage case onboarding, loan-file evidence review, policy-replay review, and audit-packet drafting with fixed safety boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Mortgage evidence-review skills with fixed safety boundaries.
interface.longDescription: Mortgate Cowork exposes the four Mortgate product skills (mortgage-case-onboarding, loan-file-evidence-review, policy-replay-review, audit-packet-draft) as agent skills. It is an employee evidence-review workflow: extract and organize evidence, compare supplied policy replays, and draft audit packets for human review. It never approves/denies credit, sets pricing, issues notices, or updates loan systems.
defaultPrompt: Review this loan file for missing evidence.
Compare expected and actual policy replay results.
Prepare an audit packet for a human reviewer.
